title: The Iran war is unpopular, but will it cost Trump the midterms? Our reporters answer your questions
summary: The war with Iran is reshaping America ahead of the midterms – how will it affect US voters at the polls? Join us for a live conversation on Oct. 6 at 12pm EDT with political and global…
byline: Lauren Gambino, Joseph Gedeon, Andrew Roth, Will Craft and Robert Tait

blocks.text: Welcome to our latest US midterms live Q&A – just over a month away from election day on Nov. 3.

The war with Iran has had major implications for Americans’ wallets, government spending and US foreign policy. It’s has also been an important factor in reshaping the political landscape as the war enters its eighth month, with the 2026 US midterms quickly approaching.
Our team of reporters has helped readers understand the costs of the war and political consequences for Trump and candidates running in November. So, how could the war affect US voters at the polls?

Joining us on Tuesday at 12pm EDT are senior political correspondent Lauren Gambino, political breaking news reporter Joseph Gedeon, global affairs correspondent Andrew Roth, data editor Will Craft and political correspondent Robert Tait.
